name: crypto-inr-payments
description: Crypto to INR instant payments platform using x402 protocol

scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:web
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@crypto-inr/server
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@crypto-inr/web
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/.next apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
